sloka: स राक्षसानां कदनं चकार सुमहाकपिः।वृतो वानरसैन्येन कालान्तकयमोपमः ।। ६.८२.८ ।।
transliteration: sa rākṣasānāṁ kadanaṁ cakāra sumahākapiḥ।vṛto vānarasainyena kālāntakayamopamaḥ ।। 6.82.8 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara army surrounded that great monkey, Hanuman, who was like Yama, the god of death and caused havoc to Rakshasas.
